segments.name: Wireless
segments.description: Provides wireless communications and broadband services, devices and accessories to postpaid and prepaid customers, businesses and wholesale partners in the United States.
segments.evidence: We manage our business activities on a consolidated basis and operate as a single operating segment: Wireless.

revenueModel.text: Postpaid and prepaid customers pay for wireless communications and broadband services, devices and accessories, while wholesale partners pay for network access.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the majority of our service revenues by providing wireless communications and broadband services to postpaid and prepaid customers.
